rationale: One missing localized check: Asterinas has no epoll loop/nesting detection at all (grep for ELOOP|MAX_NESTS|loop_check|cycle across kernel/src/events/epoll/ and kernel/src/syscall/epoll.rs returns zero hits), so EPOLL_CTL_ADD of an epoll fd that would close a cycle succeeds instead of returning ELOOP. This is Linux ep_loop_check (fs/eventpoll.c), and the fix is contained in EpollFile::add_interest (kernel/src/events/epoll/file.rs:87): downcast the target to EpollFile and walk its interest set, which is already an enumerable Mutex<BTreeSet<EntryHolder>> (file.rs:42), bounded by EP_MAX_NESTS. Host confirms the premise: 1 passed / 0 failed on the pinned LTP 20260529 prebuilt, expecting ELOOP(40) at epoll_ctl05.c:61. Chose it over the alternatives because it needs no test infrastructure (no needs_rofs, mount_device, all_filesystems or needs_root) and no absent subsystem. Ruled out, with reasons: mincore01-04, mlock01, munlock01, splice01, splice02, tee01, remap_file_pages01 are absent from both syscall dispatch tables, so they are missing-feature verdicts not bugs; pipe2_04 and epoll_wait06 depend on F_SETPIPE_SZ, which has zero hits in kernel/src; pipe2_01 needs O_DIRECT pipe packet mode; sched_getattr01 needs the whole SCHED_DEADLINE class; kill05 uses SAFE_SHMGET/SHMAT in setup and SysV shm is unwired in arch/x86.rs, so it would TBROK before the assertion; the ~23 socket candidates (accept01-03, connect01-02, send/recv/sendto/recvmsg/sendmsg, setsockopt01/04, shutdown01) are blocked by the unsupported INADDR_ANY bind that run-OgXQbF already abandoned on; fcntl12 is open04's RLIMIT_NOFILE defect (its diagnose names dup_ceil, the F_DUPFD path) and fdatasync02 is fsync03's pipe-EINVAL defect, both already fixed on branches; chdir01, openat02 and creat09 need mount_device; clock_gettime04 is a 5ms timing-jitter test; setpriority01 is a real localized defect (as root, RLIMIT_NICE=0 makes any negative nice hit the EACCES arm at set_priority.rs:35 with no CAP_SYS_NICE bypass) but sits in the same function run-XCbdtE already rewrote for setpriority02.
notes: epoll_ctl04 (all.txt line 187 is epoll_ctl05; epoll_ctl04 is line 186) almost certainly shares this root cause -- it also expects ELOOP, for exceeding the nesting depth rather than closing a cycle, and Linux enforces both in ep_loop_check. It is deliberately NOT in pool_entries and stays blocked, so this commit remains one test; if the depth bound falls out of the fix it is the natural next round. Verify configuration is the default (no workdir override) since the entry comes from all.txt. Related but distinct prior work: run-rVlQYu committed epoll_ctl02, whose fix adds an EINVAL self-add identity check plus a pollability EPERM check; a self-add is a cycle of length 1, so whoever fixes this must keep that EINVAL arm intact and ordered before the ELOOP path. That branch is unmerged, so base e8f2b9ca6 does not contain it and there is no conflict for this run. I spent no Asterinas boot in this phase: select.cache already holds probe=fail for epoll_ctl05 at commit e8f2b9ca6, identical to this run's base_commit, which cache.md rates usable as-is, and I verified that record came from run-STzXZ3/run-UceFMi whose select.json run_vars are empty, so it is a default-workdir observation and not exfat/ext2 contamination. Both host runs recorded to select.cache.
